S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  07.10. C528 No.1761 of 2025  2025 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1203 of 2025, pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 3 &
Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and Section 3 read with Section 4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Mohd. Shafy, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondent nos.1 and 2.
3.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate, has submitted that the allegations in the First Information Report are totally false.
The applicant no.1 is the husband of the respondent no.3 - informant.
He wants to live with his wife, the respondent no.3.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent nos.1 and 2 has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit, if any.
5. Notice is being issued to the respondent no.3.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.1203 of 2025 are stayed.
7. The applicant no.1 and the respondent no.3 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 09.12.2025 at 10:30 a.m.

07.10.2025 Pant/
